prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ARIMA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) matching y_true's upward trend across both folds, while ONLY_CWT_catboost captures seasonality best (0.949 correlation). FT_catboost dominates overall with lowest RMSE (31.21) and excels at both early and late horizons. The extreme RMSE spread ratio (71.65) and concept drift detection suggest STL-hierarchical stacking is optimal to exploit decomposition while handling non-stationarity.
